_note: The oracle. Written by hand from the situations the fixture builds, for the reasons named in fixture/MANIFEST.md. It is never recomputed from the classifier, which is the only way a comparison can fail.

infra-cdk-baseline.because: a repository with its own history is not residue, whatever the directory count says

api-gateway-wt-oauth-refresh.because: files that are in no commit exist only in this directory

web-console-wt-billing-table.because: tracked files were modified and not committed

api-gateway-wt-rate-limits.because: the established reference branch does not contain these commits

web-console-wt-checkout-v2.because: a moved worktree is repaired, not forgotten

api-gateway-wt-on-external-volume.because: a lock is a decision someone already took, usually about storage that is not always there

worker-pipeline-wt-local-env.because: an ignored entry outside the assumed rebuildable list may be the only copy of something
worker-pipeline-wt-local-env.evidence_contains: rebuildability and backup status were not checked

web-console-wt-search-filters.because: recent activity is work in flight

api-gateway-wt-legacy-export.because: clean, contained in the reference branch, and old, with the checks read and the remaining confirmations named

web-console-wt-old-typography.because: ignored entries assumed to be build output are not a reason to preserve

vendor-sdk-wt-patch-2.because: the owner repository is outside the roots the scan was given

worker-pipeline-wt-retry-policy.because: the metadata directory is gone, so the attachment cannot be read

web-console-copy-2.because: no repository under the scanned roots claims this directory
